expected_findings.behavior: The runner adds independent continue-on-error and dry-run flags with overlapping branches instead of modeling the execution mode explicitly.
expected_findings.impact: New modes can create unreviewed flag combinations with contradictory behavior, forcing every caller and test to reason about a growing boolean state space.
evidence: The head adds two booleans and branches on their combinations inside Run.
The existing runner has one execution path and no mode contract for callers to preserve.
